## Account and settlement structure

For Adyen in-person payments, a company account has one or more merchant accounts, each of which can have physical stores with store IDs. Merchant accounts receive payouts and reconciliation reports; account groups do not merge payouts. A terminal must be assigned to a store or merchant account in the same location where it is used, requiring at least one merchant account per country/region. Adyen presents per-store merchant accounts and merchant accounts per legal entity, country/region, or brand with stores underneath as business-dependent choices; settlement currency, reporting granularity, Customer Area access, and finance allocation differ. This account setup applies across in-person solutions, not just Terminal API messaging.
warnings: Keep terminal assignment and account hierarchy separate from Terminal API request semantics; the page gives business trade-offs, not one mandatory merchant/store model.
